newsitem.title: UKRAINE: FORECAST-Ukraine Mar inflation seen under 1.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Ukraine Mar inflation seen under 1.2 pct.

text.p: Ukraine's monthly inflation rate in March should be no more than 1.2 percent and inflation in the first three months of the year should be about 4.6 percent, Deputy Prime Minister Viktor Pynzenyk said at the weekend.
"According to our forecast, the inflation rate for March would be no more than February's level," Pynzenyk told Reuters.
February monthly inflation slowed to 1.2 percent from 2.2 percent in January.
Inflation rate over the first three months of 1996 was 21 percent, the Statistics Ministry said.
Ukraine's draft budget foresees annual inflation of 25 percent this year, compared to 39.7 percent in 1996 and 181.7 percent in 1995.
Annual inflation soared to more than 10,000 percent in 1993.
Parliament is expected to debate and pass the 1997 budget this month.
